text: This is a message for men. If a woman gives you any type of fashion or beauty advice, take it. She's always right. She wants you to shave your beard, guess what? You're gonna look 5,000 times better. If she tells you to get rid of those heinous skinny jeans and put on some baggy jeans, do it. You will probably look delicious. If she tells you to get a new haircut, cut the hair. No, women are not always right. And the last thing you should do as a man is blindly change yourself just because your girlfriend told you so. That's not confidence. That's being a puppet. Here's the truth. Sometimes women give good suggestions. Maybe a cleaner haircut, a better fit of clothes. Fine. But the final decision has to be yours. Because if you constantly change yourself just to please her, you lose respect in her eyes. Women are attracted to men who know who they are, not to men who jump at every command like a trained dog. And let's be honest. Women don't all agree with each other. One girl will tell you, shave the beard. Another will tell you, grow it out. Who is right then? The answer is simple. The one you agree with. Because it's your face, it's your style, it's your identity. Yes, self-improvement matters. But it should come from self-respect, not from fear of upsetting your girlfriend. The moment you give away that power, you stop being the man in the relationship. Bottom line, take advice if it makes sense to you. But don't ever let a woman redesign you into something you are not. Respect yourself first. That's what actually makes you attractive.
